context: A mom guides her young son through homework on a cold day
purpose: Teach: いたる/現われ/手助け/めざし/暖房/目前/５つ/反動

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、暖房つけたから、そろそろ宿題始めようか。
lines.en: Sho, I turned the heater on, so let's start your homework soon.
lines.style: Warm maternal coaxing on a cold afternoon

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…でも算数むずかしくて、もうあきらめそう。手助けしてほしい。
lines.en: Yeah... but math is hard, I'm about to give up. I want your help.
lines.style: Whiny child voice seeking gentle support

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 大丈夫、ママがそばにいるよ。問題は全部で５つだけだから、満点めざして一緒にがんばろう。
lines.en: It's okay, Mom is right here. There are only five problems total, so let's aim for a perfect score together.
lines.style: Encouraging singsong tone with motherly cheer

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: テストが目前なのに、まだ全然分からないよ。
lines.en: The test is right around the corner and I still don't get it at all.
lines.style: Anxious child near tears about the exam

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 焦らないで。ゆっくり考えれば、ちゃんと答えにいたるから。
lines.en: Don't panic. If you think slowly, you'll properly arrive at the answer.
lines.style: Calm reassuring mother slowing the pace gently

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あっ、ちょっと分かってきた感じが現われた気がする！
lines.en: Oh, a feeling of getting it just started to show up in my head!
lines.style: Bright surprised child having a small breakthrough

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ほらね。でも頑張りすぎると、その反動で疲れちゃうから、終わったらココアにしようね。
lines.en: See? But if you push too hard, the rebound makes you tired, so let's have cocoa when you're done.
lines.style: Proud gentle mother offering a sweet warm reward
